title: LausGroup's Premier Cars BMW – Pampanga: The First Retail.Next Showroom in the Philippines!
excerpt: On February 27, 2025, LausGroup's Premier Cars BMW – Pampanga proudly became the first Retail.Next showroom in the Philippines.
description:
On February 27, 2025, LausGroup's Premier Cars BMW – Pampanga proudly became the first Retail.Next showroom in the Philippines. This transformation goes beyond aesthetics. It redefines the BMW experience, offering an immersive space designed for every driving enthusiast.

As an official BMW dealership, we are at the forefront of electrification, making electric mobility more accessible to our customers in the North, with the launch of the all-new BMW iX1 eDrive20 and the activation of our BMW EV Charger.

title: LausGroup Chairman and CEO Ms. Lisset Laus-Velasco is 2024's Most Outstanding Kapampangan Awardee for Business
excerpt: Congratulations to the LausGroup of Companies Chairman and CEO, Ms. Lisset Laus-Velasco, for being this year's Most Outstanding Kapampangan 2024 Awardee for Business.
description:
Congratulations to the LausGroup of Companies Chairman and CEO, Ms. Lisset Laus-Velasco, for being this year's Most Outstanding Kapampangan 2024 Awardee for Business.

This success is a testament to her hard work and commitment. We are grateful to have such a motivating and supportive leader guiding us. Here's to many more achievements and continued success in the future!

title: FUSO PAMPANGA SUCCEEDS AT THE 2024 FUSO DEALER CONFERENCE
excerpt: FUSO Pampanga celebrated a remarkable achievement at the 2024 FUSO Dealer Conference held at Okada Manila.
description: FUSO Pampanga celebrated a remarkable achievement at the 2024 FUSO Dealer Conference held at Okada Manila. This annual event brought together all FUSO dealers nationwide that features networking opportunities, insights gathering, discovering new strategies, and an overall interactive activity. One of the key highlights of the conference is the recognition of outstanding dealerships that performed exceptionally in the area of sales & marketing, operations, and finance. Represented by Carisa A. Laus (Vice President and Executive Director, LausGroup), Alfie M. Adriano (Executive Vice President & Group COO, LausGroup), Manuelito R. Eugenio (FAVP - Operations Director/Group Head, LausGroup), Joeffrey Lacaba (Business Manager, Carworld FUSO Pampanga), and Marie Janila Galang (After Sales Head, Carworld FUSO Pampanga), the team proudly accepted the prestigious Overall Audit Compliance Excellence - Champion award for three consecutive years (2022, 2023, and 2024), Digital Sales Champion, and the Marketing Excellence award. These accolades reflect Carworld FUSO Pampanga's commitment to operational excellence and innovation in serving its valued truck customers. It's a testament to the entire team's dedication, hard work, and passion. And most importantly, the continued trust and support of their valued clients made this all possible as they are the primary drivers of the dealer's success. Together, we’re moving forward!
